name: @colox/theme
description: Colox design & theme system: tokens, theme CSS, theme compiler CLI and theme runtime

scripts.build: pnpm run tokens:sync && pnpm run emit:themes
scripts.build:tokens: pnpm run tokens:sync && pnpm run emit:themes
scripts.emit:themes: style-dictionary build --config sd-palette.config.mjs && style-dictionary build --config sd.config.mjs && style-dictionary build --config sd-dark.config.mjs && node scripts/emit-cli-data.mjs && node scripts/emit-index-css.mjs
